artboards.title: v5 — the shell and the log

annotations.text:
Shell decisions (design/research-v5.md → Synthesis):

· sidebar 232px, same ground as the page, one hairline
· three sections — log / ask / you — 32px rows, 16px icons, active = ink level, no pill
· sessions only under the active section, indented to 28px, one line each, under one dim 'chats' header
· account row pinned at the bottom, one hairline above it
· Ask column 720px centered
· composer one tier, 56px, full column, hairline under it — no send button, no model selector
· the empty state is the tonight opener, and its Play is the only accent in the view

Every word on these boards is real: the memory and the 'what do I like?' answer are Jake's, the logged rows are his log with the buckets converted (liked → 8, seen → seen, want → want), the note on Heat is his, and the posters are the real TMDB artwork.

Standing rules held: no bordered cards, no stat tiles, no uppercase tracked labels, mono for figures only, posters the only colour, one accent doing one job.

At 390 the sidebar becomes a bottom tab bar with the same three sections; sessions move inside Ask, reached from the top bar. Rows go two-line at 52px, the row of ten goes five and five at 44px, the tonight pick becomes a block with Play full-width, and the chip and filter rows scroll sideways — cut at the screen edge on purpose.
